mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5% across any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate accelerating labor market contraction, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units combined with retail sales (RSAFS) below 650,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the combined signal of HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 650000 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 and real GDP (GDPC1) below 20000 billion dollars signal economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate investment stalls.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 105 and GDPC1 < 20000 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In post-inflation shock recovery, housing starts (HOUST) above 1450 thousand units combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL change < 0.2pp) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as spending rebounds.
failure_condition: In post-inflation shock recovery, the combined signal of HOUST > 1450 and CPIAUCSL change < 0.2pp fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
